# apple_apps (Data Source)

Lists the app records that match every given filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_apps" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bundle_ids` (Set of String) Bundle identifiers to match.
- `names` (Set of String) Names to match.
- `skus` (Set of String) SKUs to match.

### Read-Only

- `apps` (Attributes List) The matching apps, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps))

<a id="nestedatt--apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps`

Read-Only:

- `bundle_id` (String) Bundle identifier of the app, e.g. `com.example.app`.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID (Apple ID) of the app.
- `name` (String) Name of the app.
- `primary_locale` (String) Primary locale of the app, e.g. `en-US`.
- `sku` (String) SKU of the app.
